title: Profile
description: User profile with biography, avatar, website, location, occupation, interests, social links, verification status, and follower statistics. Used for social media platforms, professional networks, and user profile systems.

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user this profile belongs to

avatar.description: URL to the user's profile picture or avatar

interests.description: Array of user interests or hobbies

social_links.description: Object containing links to social media profiles (e.g., twitter, linkedin, github)

is_verified.description: Whether the profile is verified as authentic

followers_count.description: Total number of users following this profile

following_count.description: Total number of users this profile is following
